'''Astrelle''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==
She is plump with a formidable bosom.

==History==
She is an arithmetist.

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split. 

In the White Tower, [[Alviarin]] hears her discussing statistical methods relating to the failing of the [[Keeping]]s on the food storerooms in the Tower.
